description: This file manages email and SMS notifications for calendar events, including sending various types of emails and SMS messages related to event scheduling, rescheduling, cancellations, attendee management, and organization settings.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Utility function to send an email by preparing a BaseEmail instance and invoking its sendEmail method.

methods.name: fetchOrganizationEmailSettings
methods.description: Fetches email settings for a given organization ID from the database.

methods.name: shouldSkipAttendeeEmailWithSettings
methods.description: Determines whether to skip sending attendee emails based on organization settings and event metadata.

methods.name: _sendScheduledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends scheduled emails and SMS for a calendar event, including organizer and attendee notifications.

methods.name: sendScheduledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Wrapped version of _sendScheduledEmailsAndSMS with reporting.

methods.name: sendReassignedScheduledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends emails and SMS for reassigned scheduled events to team members.

methods.name: sendRoundRobinRescheduledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Handles rescheduling notifications for round robin bookings, including attendees and team members.

methods.name: sendReassignedUpdatedEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends update emails and SMS to attendees when an event is reassigned.

methods.name: sendRoundRobinCancelledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends cancellation notifications for round robin events to team members and attendees.

methods.name: sendReassignedEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends reassignment notifications to team members.

methods.name: _sendRescheduledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends rescheduling notifications for an event, including organizer and attendees.

methods.name: sendRescheduledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Wrapped version of _sendRescheduledEmailsAndSMS with reporting.

methods.name: sendRescheduledSeatEmailAndSMS
methods.description: Sends rescheduling notifications for a specific attendee's seat change.

methods.name: sendScheduledSeatsEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends notifications for seat scheduling, including attendee and organizer notifications.

methods.name: sendCancelledSeatEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends notifications for seat cancellations to attendees and organizers.

methods.name: _sendOrganizerRequestEmail
methods.description: Sends organizer request emails to all team members.

methods.name: sendOrganizerRequestEmail
methods.description: Wrapped version of _sendOrganizerRequestEmail with reporting.

methods.name: _sendAttendeeRequestEmailAndSMS
methods.description: Sends attendee request emails and SMS for event rescheduling.

methods.name: sendAttendeeRequestEmailAndSMS
methods.description: Wrapped version of _sendAttendeeRequestEmailAndSMS with reporting.

methods.name: sendDeclinedEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends decline notifications to attendees and SMS alerts.

methods.name: sendCancelledEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends cancellation emails and SMS alerts for an event.

methods.name: sendOrganizerRequestReminderEmail
methods.description: Sends reminder emails for organizer requests.

methods.name: sendAwaitingPaymentEmailAndSMS
methods.description: Sends emails and SMS for attendees awaiting payment.

methods.name: sendRequestRescheduleEmailAndSMS
methods.description: Sends emails and SMS for event rescheduling requests.

methods.name: sendLocationChangeEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends location change notifications via email and SMS.

methods.name: sendAddGuestsEmails
methods.description: Sends emails to add guests to an event.

methods.name: sendAddGuestsEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends emails and SMS for adding guests.

methods.name: sendAddAttendeeEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends emails and SMS for adding attendees.

methods.name: sendCancelledSeatEmailsAndSMS
methods.description: Sends seat cancellation notifications.
